_about.purpose: Say what kind of video each source is, so retrieval and grading can tell Nassim's own recommendations apart from training vlogs with guests, analyses of other people's programs and off-scope fat loss content. Without it, a passage where Nassim describes or criticizes a practice can be cited as if he recommended it.
_about.used_by: src/ingestion/chunker.py: copies content_type and speaker onto every chunk of the video.
_about.status: Proposed from the video titles and a look at the transcripts (2026-10-26). Review a type when in doubt: open the video or data/corpus/clean_txt/<video_id>.txt.
_about.how_to_use_in_retrieval: Prefer 'advice', 'program' and 'ranking' as evidence for prescriptions. Treat 'session_vlog', 'coaching_case' and 'third_party_analysis' as weaker evidence (several voices, or commentary on someone else). 'fat_loss_nutrition' is outside the MVP scope.

types.advice: Nassim explains a training topic on his own (principles, mistakes, how-to).
types.program: Nassim prescribes a complete program or session with its variables (exercises, sets, reps, rest).
types.ranking: Exercises for one muscle ranked from best to worst: the main source for substitutions.
types.session_vlog: Filmed training session, usually with a guest: two voices mixed with no speaker labels, opinions may differ.
types.coaching_case: Nassim coaches one specific person: advice adapted to that person.
types.third_party_analysis: Nassim analyses someone else's program, physique or technique: the text often describes practices he does not recommend.
types.fat_loss_nutrition: Mainly fat loss, cardio or nutrition: outside the MVP scope.

speakers.mixed: Nassim Sahili + guest (voices mixed, not labelled)
speakers.commentary: Nassim Sahili (commenting on a third party)
